name: site-toast.scss
html:
// ─── Site Toast ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Failure/notice pill stack. Desktop: bottom-right column above the fold edge.
// Mobile: full-width bottom bar so thumb-reach dismiss stays easy. The accent
// edge bar uses the site accent token — same dark-glass language as the
// stats HUD and cookie banner.

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

$_B_TOAST: 'site-toast';

.#{$_B_TOAST} {
  position: fixed;
  right: to-rem($space-xl);
  bottom: calc(#{to-rem($space-xl)} + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  z-index: var(--z-top);

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);

  max-width: to-rem(400);
  pointer-events: none;

  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 300;

  // Mobile: span the viewport edge-to-edge, stack above the bottom nav
  @media (max-width: $bk-768) {
    left: to-rem($space-sm);
    right: to-rem($space-sm);
    bottom: calc(#{to-rem($space-sm)} + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    max-width: none;
  }

  &-item {
    pointer-events: auto;

    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: to-rem($space-md);

    padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-lg);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    border: var(--border-item-hover);
    border-left: to-rem($space-2xs) solid var(--color-accent);
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78); // pure black alpha — no theme hex
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(#{to-rem($space-md)});
    backdrop-filter: blur(#{to-rem($space-md)});
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);

    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    line-height: 1.4;

    animation: #{$_B_TOAST}-in 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;

    // Backdrop blur is expensive on mobile GPUs — solid fallback like cookies
    @media (max-width: $bk-768) {
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
      backdrop-filter: none;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.92);
    }
  }

  &-title {
    display: block;

    margin: 0 0 to-rem($space-2xs);

    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: to-rem($space-md);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: to-rem(0.6);
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  &-text {
    flex: 1;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  &-close {
    flex: 0 0 auto;

    margin: calc(-1 * #{to-rem($space-2xs)}) calc(-1 * #{to-rem($space-2xs)}) 0 0;
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm);

    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    opacity: 0.7;
    font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
    line-height: 1;
    cursor: pointer;

    transition: opacity 0.2s ease;

    &:hover,
    &:focus-visible {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      // --color-accent is near-invisible on light surfaces; the contrast
      // variant keeps the focus ring ≥3:1 in both themes (WCAG 2.4.13).
      outline: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--color-accent-contrast);
      outline-offset: to-rem($space-2xs);
    }
  }
}

@keyframes #{$_B_TOAST}-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(to-rem($space-sm), to-rem($space-sm));
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

// Reduced motion: skip the slide-in entirely
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .#{$_B_TOAST}-item {
    animation: none;
  }
}
